name: OpenAI Codex CLI

login.describe: A ChatGPT plan's login, one directory per login on the node: run `codex login --device-auth` with CODEX_HOME set to the login's directory. Only its auth.json is copied into a run, and copied back when codex refreshes it.

preamble: You are working in a git repository checked out for you at /work, on a branch of its own. Leave your changes in the working tree: voice commits them when you finish. Do not push, and do not change the repository's remotes or git configuration. End with a short summary of what you changed; its first line is the change's title.
